description:
About the job

Job Title: RevOps Specialist | Remote




Location: Latin America

Salary: $3,200-$3,800/month gross

Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week (Flexible - 10am - 6pm ET with a lunch break).




Only English CVs will be accepted.




Retalent Agency is a global remote recruitment agency that connects talented professionals like you with top companies in e-commerce, marketing, and tech. Since 2019, we’ve helped hundreds of candidates from Latin America, Eastern Europe, Asia, and South Africa land full-time remote roles with international teams.

When you apply through Retalent, you’re not just applying for a job; you’re stepping into a community of growing businesses and ambitious professionals.




Let us help you find the right opportunity to grow your career from anywhere in the world.




Our Client:

Founded by a nurse who knew healthcare needed a better answer to burnout and career misalignment, this company has spent the past decade building the definitive path for nurses who want more than the bedside. What started as one-on-one mentoring for nurse entrepreneurs has grown into the leading certification program in the country, having trained hundreds of nurse coaches to build thriving practices of their own.




Built on the belief that health can't be coached in isolation from the rest of a client's life, they set out to fix a gap the industry hadn't named: most "health coaching" was really life coaching, without the structure or training to back it up. Now, they equip nurses with the skills and confidence to coach the whole person, health, relationships, mindset, and work-life balance, whether that's in a private practice or inside an organization.




They are a mission-driven team that believes nurses deserve a second act built on their own terms. Everything they build lives by one standard: give nurses the most affordable, most supported path to a coaching career that actually works.




In This Role, You’ll:




Act as the steady hands behind a growing RevOps system, keeping HubSpot clean, organized, and running the way it's supposed to. This is a support and execution role built around your ability to work inside an existing playbook, catch what others miss, and make sure nothing slips through the cracks, without needing to rebuild the system to feel useful.




You'll work closely with the RevOps team as the person who keeps the tech stack humming: maintaining contacts, views, properties, and workflows in HubSpot, triaging support requests from the sales team, and QA-ing automations before they go live. Tools like Google Sheets and HubSpot are core to how this team operates, and you'll use them daily to keep data clean and processes documented. Your attention to detail, follow-through, and comfort working within someone else's system are what make this role, and the path to a Senior RevOps position, possible.




What You'll Be Doing




Perform ongoing HubSpot maintenance: cleaning up contacts, views, properties, workflows, and reports 
Triage and resolve incoming tech support requests (calendar issues, HubSpot questions from the sales team, etc.) 
Execute delegated HubSpot tasks including updating contact views, adjusting workflow logic, and QA-ing automations 
Help document and organize RevOps processes across the funnel 
Attend a weekly project review to get updates, ask questions, and report progress 
Flag issues proactively when something looks off 




What You Won't Be Doing 




This role is not about coming in with your own systems or rebuilding what exists. You'll be working within a defined tech stack and following detailed playbooks. 
If you're someone who needs to overhaul everything to feel productive, this probably isn't the right fit. 




What You’ll Bring:




Must Have




2-4 years of hands-on HubSpot experience; you understand how contacts, deals, workflows, and properties relate to each other
Fluent English, C1 or advanced
Strong Google Sheets experience
Experience with n8n and Claude (or similar AI/automation tools) 
You're comfortable working inside someone else's system without needing to rearchitect it 
Catch the details others miss (wrong property, wrong pipeline filter, data going to the wrong place) 
Communicate clearly and proactively; you ask good questions before going deep on the wrong thing 
Can manage your own time and hit deadlines without heavy oversight 
Have worked in a similar support or ops assistant capacity before




Nice to Have




Familiarity with tools like Salesmessage, Kajabi, or Zapier 
Experience in an education, coaching, or digital-services business 
Prior experience supporting a RevOps or sales/marketing ops team 




What’s In It for You:




Competitive salary: $3,200 to $3,800 gross per month.
Possibility to grow into a Senior RevOps Role as they grow
100% remote position, work from anywhere
Paid US holidays, plus 10 days of PTO

description:
About the job

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Our Marketing Growth team runs the consumer programs that reach millions of shoppers — subscriptions, giveaways, surveys, and lifecycle campaigns across email, push, in-app, and landing pages. This role sits where marketing meets data, engineering and product. You'll write the queries that tell us whether a program actually worked, design the tests that answer questions we'd otherwise be guessing at, and translate between the marketing team and the engineers who build the surfaces we run on.

As a Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern, you will play a critical role in measuring and improving the programs that drive our consumer business. A core focus will be writing the queries and building the reporting that tell us whether a program worked, and designing the tests that answer the questions we would otherwise be guessing at. In addition to analysis, you will work closely with Product and Engineering to translate marketing needs into clear requirements and to identify what we would need built to make new programs possible. This role is well suited to someone with a technical background who is drawn to the business and product side of the work, and who wants exposure to how marketing decisions actually get made.

What You'll Do:

Answer questions with data


Write your own SQL to pull campaign, cohort, and subscription performance.
Track the metrics that drive the business: DAU, NTM, LTV, CAC
Compare performance across time periods and segments, and flag the shifts that matter before anyone asks.
Take ownership of the dashboards behind our decisions, and use AI to find the answers hiding in them


Design and measure experiments


Help design A/B tests across channels — audience splits, variants, and success metrics defined before anything launches
Write the post-test analysis: what worked, what didn't, what we do differently next time
Own consumer surveys from request to results: define and query the audience, launch, monitor completion, report back what we learned, and optimize the process


Bridge marketing and engineering


Turn marketing needs into specs and tickets an engineer can act on 
Investigate when something breaks — trace an issue through dashboards and logs back to its source
QA new product features and surfaces, and help decide how marketing should be using them
Spot underused channels and product surfaces, and propose how marketing could leverage them


Automate And Improve How We Work


Use AI tools (Claude and similar) to build leverage into your own work — recurring reports, first-pass analyses, triage. If a task comes back every week, we'd rather you automate it
Build automations and templates the rest of the team can use
Own recurring operational queues and look for the pattern behind repeat problems instead of just clearing them


What We Look For:

Skills & Competencies


Basic working knowledge of SQL.
Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, or HTML/CSS, and enough comfort reading code. 
More interested in the business and product side than in engineering for its own sake. You want to know why the number moved, not only how the system works
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
You get the most out of AI. Claude, ChatGPT, or similar are already part of how you work — research, summaries, first-pass analyses — and you're constantly exploring what else they can handle
Comfort working in agile, matrixed teams with multiple inputs and quick turnarounds
A strong bias for action


Educational & Professional Experience


Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in engineering, computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, or a related technical field
Exposure to BI tools (Redash/SIA, Looker, Tableau, or similar) is a plus
Prior experience with a CRM platform like Braze is a plus
Any experience with product management, experiment design, or A/B testing is a plus
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Key brands include Pinnacle Business Academy, Mindful Practice Podcast, Phoenix Medical Spa, Phoenix Ascend Press, and related ventures. Responsibilities:

· Build and maintain an organized content calendar across assigned brands and platforms.

· Create branded static graphics, short-form video/reels, promotional assets, engagement posts, and other platform-appropriate content.

· Write clear captions, hooks, calls to action, promotional copy, and audience-engagement copy that matches each brand.

· Repurpose podcasts, interviews, speaking appearances, webinars, articles, book content, educational material, and founder ideas into multiple social assets.

· Schedule and publish content consistently using approved workflows and platform tools.

· Maintain brand standards, including correct logos, colors, fonts, tone, audience, offer, and CTA for each business.

· Support community engagement, including Facebook-group prompts, comments, audience interaction, and basic moderation where assigned.

· Coordinate with the Operations & Systems VA when campaigns require landing pages, forms, automations, lead capture, or backend changes.

· Maintain an organized content library and asset bank so approved material can be efficiently reused and repurposed.

· Track basic performance metrics such as reach, engagement, follower growth, clicks, inquiries, and lead-driving content, and summarize meaningful trends.




Must Have Skills:

· Strong social-media content planning and calendar-management skills; must be capable of maintaining a consistent cadence without daily prompting.

· Excellent copywriting for captions, hooks, CTAs, promotional posts, and engagement content.

· Strong Canva or comparable visual-design capability, with demonstrated ability to follow an established brand rather than redesign it arbitrarily.

· Short-form video editing and repurposing skills for reels, clips, and platform-native content.

· Ability to turn one long-form asset into multiple useful pieces of content across platforms.

· Excellent attention to brand detail, including correct logo, colors, typography, voice, audience, and CTA.

· Strong organization and file-management habits for content libraries, templates, raw media, approvals, and scheduled posts.

· Working knowledge of social analytics and the ability to explain what is working, what is not, and what should change.

· Professional written English and the judgment to represent physician-led healthcare and professional brands appropriately.

· Reliability and deadline ownership; missed deadlines or obstacles must be communicated before the deadline, not afterward.




Preferred Experience:

· Experience creating content for healthcare, physicians, coaches, consultants, educators, authors, podcasts, or professional-service businesses.

· Experience supporting multiple brands or business lines simultaneously.

· Familiarity with podcast clips, book launches, webinars, lead magnets, community-building, event promotion, and conversion-focused campaigns.

· Basic familiarity with GoHighLevel or another CRM is helpful for coordinating lead-generation campaigns, but deep systems administration is not required.




Success in this Role Looks Like:

· Content is planned ahead instead of created at the last minute.

· Each brand remains visually and verbally distinct and accurate.

· Founder-generated ideas and long-form content are regularly repurposed without requiring the founder to rewrite every post.

· Publishing remains consistent even during busy clinical, academic, travel, or speaking periods.

· Analytics are used to improve future content rather than merely reported.

· The founder is reviewing strategy and key approvals, not functioning as the day-to-day social-media manager.

About the job

Job Title: Social Media Content Creator & Brand Executor
Job ID: RANDJ2
Industry: Health & Wellness | Medical Aesthetics | Telehealth 🩺✨
Location: LATAM 🌎 (Spanish Required)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Schedule: Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST ⏰
Compensation: 💰 $8–$12/hour (Based on Experience & Skills)
Start Date: ASAP 🚀




💼 About the Role

We are building an integrated wellness ecosystem and we need someone who creates content that actually performs. The brand foundation, voice guidelines, and content pillars are already built. We are not looking for a strategist. We need a bilingual content creator and executor who can script, shoot, edit, and publish short-form video and social content across two distinct brands, working within an existing creative framework and growing both audiences with speed and consistency.




This role spans two brands: Eterna Aesthetics & Wellness, a luxury brick-and-mortar medical aesthetics clinic serving a Spanish-speaking Latina clientele in Orlando, and Aevra Health, a national concierge telehealth platform specializing in advanced wellness and metabolic optimization. Both brands have distinct voices, audiences, and content needs. You will execute across both.




(Note: A portfolio is required. You must be able to show prior content work, brand execution, and measurable results before moving to the interview stage.)




🎯 Key Responsibilities




🎥 1. Short-Form Video Creation (Priority #1)

Script, shoot, direct, and edit Reels and TikToks for both brands at a pace of 4 to 6 pieces of short-form content per week, per brand.
Apply high-retention video frameworks including hooks, pacing, and storytelling to maximize organic reach and watch time.
Produce bilingual content with Spanish-first priority for Eterna's local Latina audience and English-primary for Aevra Health's national audience.
Repurpose long-form content and client testimonials into short-form clips across TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts.




📲 2. Content Execution Across Platforms

Own the publishing calendar across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube for both brands.
Design and produce premium static content using our custom visual identity — not generic healthcare templates. Proficiency in Canva is required; Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator experience is a strong plus.
Build and manage a content bank of templates, b-roll, and evergreen assets to maintain posting consistency.
Write bilingual captions and hooks in both English and Spanish that drive engagement and reflect each brand's distinct voice, delivering culturally nuanced copy — never a literal translation.




💬 3. ManyChat & Audience Engagement

Manage and expand ManyChat automations on Instagram and TikTok to convert comments and DMs into booked appointments and qualified leads.
Monitor and respond to comments and DMs in both English and Spanish, maintaining brand tone across all interactions.
Build comment-to-DM flows that funnel followers into the booking widget without manual follow-up.




⭐ 4. Google Business Profile & Reviews

Maintain and optimize Google Business Profile listings for local SEO.
Respond to client reviews in both English and Spanish and repurpose high-quality reviews into social media brand assets.
Support systems that consistently generate new high-star reviews from existing clients.




✍️ 5. Compliance-Safe Copywriting

Frame all content around lifestyle transformations, wellness outcomes, and confidence rather than medical claims, protecting ad accounts and organic channels from platform restrictions.
Understand compliant aesthetics marketing and apply it consistently without needing reminders.




📂 6. SOPs and Workflow Documentation

Document content workflows, brand standards, and repeatable processes in Notion so the creative system scales as the team grows.
Build asset templates and content libraries that allow production to continue consistently without bottlenecks.




🛑 What This Role Is Not

The brand strategy, content pillars, and visual identity already exist. You are not being hired to build those from scratch. You are being hired to execute them at high volume and high quality. GHL automations, lead qualification funnels, and CRM pipeline management are handled by a separate operations team member and are not part of this role.




✅ Requirements




⭐ Core Requirements:

Portfolio: Required. Must demonstrate prior content work, brand design, and measurable results before moving to the interview stage.
Language: Native or professional bilingual fluency in written and spoken English and Spanish is strictly required. Spanish-first content for Eterna's Latina audience is non-negotiable.
Experience: 2 to 4 plus years creating content for social media brands with measurable results. Proven track record in short-form video content that has grown audiences or generated significant organic reach.
Video & Design: Proficient in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or equivalent for video editing. Canva proficiency required. Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator experience is a strong plus.
Platform Knowledge: Deep understanding of TikTok and Instagram algorithm behavior, content formats, and optimization strategies including social SEO, hashtags, captions, and posting cadence.
Tech Stack: ManyChat experience is required. Familiarity with GoHighLevel, Meta Business Suite, Notion or Asana, and Google Business Dashboard is a strong plus.
Healthcare/Aesthetics: Background in medical aesthetics, luxury wellness, beauty, or lifestyle content is highly preferred. Must understand how to market in a regulated industry without making medical claims.
Documentation Mindset: Comfortable building SOPs and documenting workflows, not just executing tasks. Treats documentation as part of the deliverable.




🌟 Preferred:

Background in medical aesthetics, luxury wellness, telehealth, or premium healthcare marketing.
Experience with AI-driven automation and funnel-building beyond basic tool use.
Agency background with experience managing content across multiple brands simultaneously.

You create content because you understand what makes people stop scrolling, not because you have a template for it.

About the job

About Signant Health

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

About The Role

Reporting to the Executive Director, Global Communications, the Corporate Communications Channels Specialist is primarily responsible for the creation and distribution of internal and external communications to team members, customers and other external stakeholders. They are also responsible for creating and maintaining suitable contact databases and producing analytics that report on channel performance.

Certu Systems builds an end-to-end supply chain solution, augmented throughout with AI that is in production and load-bearing — not a lab project. Behind it is a team of world-class engineers, data scientists, and business domain experts, founded by Dr. Kim out of Carnegie Mellon.




We are hiring one exceptional person to sit at the centre of everything we do for customers, from the first discovery call to the thousandth day of live operations. This is a wide-brief, high-ownership role with no fixed edges.




We hire for raw ability, work ethic, and judgement — not pedigree. No specific degree, supply chain background, or minimum years of work experience required. Recent graduates are genuinely welcome, and we pay top of market for the right person regardless of tenure. What we do require is listed below.




What you'll do




Discovery. Sit with dispatchers, warehouse managers, transport planners, and C-suite. Understand how their business really runs, and translate it into requirements engineers can build against.
Pilot. Scope, configure, and run pilots end to end — and be honest with both the customer and us about what the results actually show.
Rollout. Own go-lives: data migration, integrations, configuration, training, cutover, and the unglamorous work of getting a sceptical night shift to trust a new system.
Daily operations. Stay with your accounts after launch. Triage issues, work incidents, chase root causes with engineering, and be the customer's trusted point of contact for as long as they're live.
Continuous improvement. You'll be closer to real usage than anyone in the company. Turn that into evidence engineering and leadership can act on — what's working, what's breaking, what needs to change — and drive the fixes through.




Who we're looking for




Exceptional reasoning ability — you can structure a messy, ambiguous problem without being handed a framework
Extreme ownership — when something is broken and it's nobody's job, it becomes yours
Communication that holds under pressure, from engineers to customers and executives
Technical fluency: comfortable with data, and systems thinking
Resilience and pace — live incidents, real deadlines, occasional travel to customer sites
Intellectual honesty — to raise your hand when you don't understand, and to obsessively devote time and energy to learning until you do
Professional Spanish and English




What we offer




Top-tier compensation, benchmarked to the best in the market and set by capability rather than seniority. Direct exposure to the executive team and every major customer from week one. Real scope to define a function and grow into leading it.




This role is demanding — broad remit, fast pace, and intense periods around go-lives. This may very well be the most difficult but rewarding challenge that you'll take up in your life.




Apply




Send a CV.
Send one page on a hard problem you owned end to end, and what you did when it went wrong.




We read every one.




Certu Systems is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate every applicant on ability and potential alone.

Oportunidad profesional en Inteligencia Artificial

Estamos en búsqueda de Ingenieros y/o especialistas en Inteligencia Artificial con mentalidad innovadora y pasión por construir soluciones avanzadas basadas en datos. Esta persona participará en el diseño e implementación de sistemas inteligentes que aprovechen modelos de lenguaje de última generación, Python y el ecosistema de Google Cloud Platform.




El rol está enfocado en el desarrollo de agentes inteligentes y arquitecturas basadas en Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) para resolver desafíos complejos y habilitar nuevas capacidades tecnológicas dentro de la organización.




Principales funciones

Desarrollo de agentes inteligentes

Construir soluciones autónomas basadas en modelos de lenguaje avanzados (familia Gemini u otros), capaces de automatizar procesos y mejorar la interacción con usuarios y sistemas.

Implementación de soluciones en la nube (GCP)

Diseñar, desplegar y operar aplicaciones de IA utilizando servicios como Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Functions y Kubernetes Engine.

Arquitecturas RAG

Diseñar pipelines que integren modelos de lenguaje con fuentes de conocimiento internas para generar respuestas contextualizadas, precisas y confiables.

Programación en Python

Desarrollar soluciones robustas utilizando herramientas del ecosistema de ciencia de datos y machine learning (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch o TensorFlow).

Optimización de prompts y evaluación de modelos

Diseñar estrategias de prompt engineering y métricas de evaluación que permitan mejorar el desempeño y confiabilidad de los modelos en entornos productivos.

Trabajo colaborativo con equipos multidisciplinarios

Convertir necesidades del negocio en soluciones técnicas y comunicar resultados de forma clara, mostrando el impacto en procesos y decisiones.




Perfil profesional

✔ 2 a 3 años de experiencia en Machine Learning, Data Science o AI Engineering.

✔ Dominio sólido de Python y librerías de análisis y aprendizaje automático.

✔ Experiencia trabajando con Google Cloud Platform, especialmente en servicios de IA y analítica.

✔ Formación en Ingeniería, Ciencias de la Computación, Matemáticas, Estadística o carreras afines.

✔ Conocimiento en LLMs, NLP, embeddings y arquitecturas modernas de modelos de lenguaje.




Se valorará adicionalmente

Experiencia práctica implementando arquitecturas RAG
Conocimiento de frameworks como LangChain, LlamaIndex u otros frameworks de agentes
Experiencia trabajando con Docker y Kubernetes
Manejo de bases de datos SQL y NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.)
Estudios de posgrado en Inteligencia Artificial o áreas relacionadas

Responsabilidades

• Diseñar y ejecutar la estrategia comercial.

• Liderar, acompañar y desarrollar al equipo de representantes de ventas.

• Elaborar pronósticos de ventas y reportes de resultados para la toma de decisiones.

• Identificar oportunidades de mercado, tendencias, competidores y necesidades de los clientes.

• Colaborar con las áreas de logística y marketing para asegurar la disponibilidad, correcta distribución y posicionamiento de los productos.




Perfil que buscamos

• Licenciatura concluida. Se dará preferencia a profesionales en Medicina Veterinaria y Zootecnia, Administración, Mercadotecnia, Negocios o carreras afines.

• Deseable contar con al menos 5 años de experiencia en ventas, desarrollo comercial o posiciones similares.

• Experiencia en distribución, venta mayorista o comercialización de productos de consumo.

• Experiencia liderando y desarrollando equipos de ventas.

title: Executive Assistant
company: The Limitless Agent Company | Real Estate Marketing | PayPerClose Leads | Founder: Oswaldo Gutierrez
description:
About the job

🚀 Senior Executive Assistant — Operations, Finance & Project Coordination




Become the operational backbone of one of the fastest-growing bilingual marketing companies in U.S. real estate — the person two founders trust to run the entire back end while they scale.




We're NOT looking for a secretary who waits to be told what to do.




We're looking for a self-managed, obsessively-organized operator who finds the gaps before we do, keeps the whole team accountable to their deadlines, and executes — the administrative backbone that keeps the company organized, on time, and moving.




🏢 WHO WE ARE




Silva Media is a fast-growing bilingual (Spanish/English) real estate marketing company serving 100+ active agents across the United States.




We install a predictable client-acquisition machine backed by a performance guarantee most agencies wouldn't dare make: 12 closings in 12 months, or the client doesn't pay.




We're building something rare — the category leader in Latino real estate marketing, in a space with virtually zero competition in Spanish. It's a blue ocean, we move fast, and we're looking for A-players who want to grow with us and build something they're genuinely proud to be part of.




🎯 THE ROLE




You are the right hand to both founders — Oz (systems & strategy) and Jimmy (sales & growth). As we grow fast, the back end of the company needs a true owner: someone who keeps every moving part organized, every deadline honored, every payment on time, and every priority visible. That's you.




You own the operational and administrative engine of the company. You keep the founders' calendars, inboxes, and day-to-day logistics running like a well-oiled machine. You orchestrate tasks and priorities across the entire team, hold people accountable to their deliverables and deadlines, and make sure the money side runs clean — clients billed on time, the team paid on time, the books reviewed and reported. You don't keep the books yourself (that's outsourced to a professional bookkeeper) — you own that relationship, review what they send back, catch what doesn't add up, and report it to the founders in plain language.




Within your first 90 days, the founders should feel you covering the back end so completely that they can pour 100% of their energy into clients, sales, and scale.




🏆 WHAT YOU OWN




1. Founders' Executive & Personal Support. Calendars, scheduling, inbox triage, meeting prep, follow-ups, and the personal logistics that keep two busy founders running smoothly. You anticipate — you don't wait to react.




2. Task & Project Orchestration + Prioritization. You are the single source of truth for what's happening and what's next. You live inside our project management tool (ClickUp, Monday, Asana, or Airtable), keep every list current, surface stale or orphaned priorities, and find the gaps before anyone asks. You don't just track tasks — you decide what matters most and keep it moving.




3. Team Accountability. You keep the whole team — and the founders — honest about their commitments. You chase what's owed, follow up on deadlines and deliverables, and make sure nothing slips through the cracks.




4. Billing & Finance Operations ("Billing Police"). You make sure every client is billed correctly and on time, and every team member is paid on time, every time. You chase overdue invoices, flag discrepancies across Square / WHOP / PandaDoc / Mercury, and keep our admin pipeline clean and current.




5. Bookkeeper Liaison & Financial Reporting. You're the bridge between Silva Media and our outsourced bookkeeper — feeding clean inputs, reviewing what comes back, catching what doesn't add up, and translating the numbers into a clear monthly picture the founders can act on.




6. SOPs & Systems Building. You turn founder-led Loom videos and tutorials into clean, written SOP Google Docs the whole team can follow — consolidating scattered notes into single-source playbooks that make communicating, delegating, and training the next hire effortless.




📊 HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED




• Team paid on time → 100%. On time, every time.

• Client billing → zero slips. No overdue or un-chased invoice goes unnoticed.

• Project system reflects reality. No stale, orphaned, or invisible priorities.

• Deliverables & deadlines tracked. The team stays accountable and on schedule.

• Monthly financial reporting → clean and on time, without the founders asking.

• Founder Escalations → Zero. Leadership stops touching the admin lane. That's the whole job.




✅ WHO THIS IS FOR




• Bilingual (Spanish/English) — fluent and professional in both, non-negotiable.

• You have 3–5+ years as an Executive Assistant, Operations Coordinator, or Integrator to a founder or busy executive.

• You've personally owned billing, invoicing, or financial operations before — and you treat a missed payment like a fire.

• You're QuickBooks-literate and comfortable reviewing books even when a third party keeps them.

• You're a power user of a project management tool (ClickUp, Monday, Asana, or Airtable) — you don't just use it, you run people through it.

• You are extremely detail-oriented and fully self-managed. Nobody has to keep you on track — you keep everyone else on track.

• You find the gaps before you're told. You see the thing nobody assigned, and you handle it.

• You can turn a messy Loom walkthrough into a clean SOP a brand-new hire could follow.

• You're AI-friendly — you use tools like Claude/ChatGPT to move faster.

• You can hold people accountable — including your bosses — without being a pushover.

• You're an executioner, not a note-taker. Things get done when they hit your desk.




🚫 THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF




• You wait to be told what to do.

• You think "I sent a reminder" means the job is done.

• Numbers, spreadsheets, or billing make you nervous.

• You confuse being nice with being effective — you can't hold a teammate (or a founder) to their word.

• You need to be managed, chased, or reminded yourself.

• You let things slip and explain why afterward instead of catching them before.




🛠 TECH STACK




QuickBooks · ClickUp (or Monday / Asana / Airtable) · Google Workspace · Slack · Mercury · WHOP · Square · PandaDoc · Claude / AI tools · GoHighLevel (a plus) · Tax-strategy knowledge (a plus)




💰 COMPENSATION




$800–$1,500 USD/month · Full-time · Remote · LATAM




📩 HOW TO APPLY




Submit a Loom video (5 minutes max) answering:




1. Walk me through a billing or payroll process you personally owned — how did you guarantee nobody ever got paid late and no client ever got missed?




2. Tell me about a time you caught a gap in priorities BEFORE anyone asked you to. What did you find, and what did you do about it?




3. How do you hold someone accountable when THEY are the bottleneck — even when it's your boss? Give me a real example.




4. Show me your organization system. Screen-share your actual ClickUp / Asana / calendar setup and walk me through how you keep yourself and others on track.




5. Why Silva Media? Why this role? Why you over 100 other applicants?




No Loom = no interview. No exceptions.

description:
About the job

Overview

About the Role & Team

IDC, a global leader in technology market intelligence, is seeking a market researcher to join our team. This role requires a mix of analytical abilities, attention to detail, proficiency in research methodologies, and excellent communication skills to convey complex information effectively.

The market researcher will play a crucial role in interpreting data, staying abreast of IT market trends and events, supporting their team through in-depth research, and collaborating to meet research objectives.

The market researcher will support the authorship and delivery of IDC’s market intelligence products and services in a rapidly evolving information technology landscape. The role will focus on utilizing the latest market research methodologies and AI tools to uncover relevant data from internal and external sources and synthesizing it into client deliverables.

What You’ll Do


 Support IDC’s market research agenda by conducting in-depth research into IT markets and their impact on industries. 
 Track, monitor, and identify IT industry developments to identify and report on market shifts, patterns, and anomalies. 
 Collaborate with internal technology market, industry, and primary research subject matter experts to achieve research goals and produce deliverables efficiently. 
 Participate in ongoing professional development and continuous team knowledge creation and sharing. 
 Synthesize raw data into information and meaningful insights and deliver tailored content components and assets that address key business requirements. 
 Contribute to the creation of written research studies and presentations. 
 Leverage AI by designing, testing, and continuously refining prompts and skills to augment IDC’s market intelligence production processes. 
 Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation across the market intelligence production workflow to impact measurable productivity gains. 


What You Bring


Bachelor’s degree required (business, economics, management information systems, technology marketing, product management, or related field).
2-3 years of experience in market research, consulting, or analysis, ideally in the information technology sector, with demonstrated ability to write research content.
Previous experience in roles such as market intelligence or competitive intelligence is preferred.
Outstanding written and strong verbal communication skills.
Proven ability to manage multiple assignments and meet tight deadlines.
Strong interpersonal skills and flexibility to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, global environment.
Demonstrated hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, or other similar tools, including creation of skills, ongoing prompt management, and occasional use of coding assistants; as well as an understanding of the benefits and shortcomings of such tools.
Experience with office productivity tools such as Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Intellectual curiosity, willingness to learn new market research methods and tools, an analytical mindset, and interest in technology markets and their impact across industries and use cases.
Professional proficiency in spoken and written English
Hybrid job, 2 days per week at the office.


Preferred Attributes


Experience working with or for technology vendors, IT distributors, or in a market research/consulting firm.
Knowledge of business models, go-to-market strategies, and technology adoption patterns in enterprise IT.
A problem solver with flexibility to adapt to rapidly changing and evolving market dynamics.
Familiarity with basic scripting, low-code/no-code automation platforms, or API-based integrations.


Why This Role Stands Out

At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.

Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.

Equal Opportunity Employer

IDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E-Verify.

If this role relocates to a different country, the salary range will be updated to reflect that country's range, rather than a currency conversion of the original range.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.




You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.




Come make an impact every day at Zebra.




What We're Looking For:

This role is responsible for driving customer satisfaction and operational efficiency by resolving complex, escalated technical issues across our industrial, mobile, and RFID printing portfolios. Utilizing deep hardware and software expertise, the successful candidate will diagnose complex print engine failures, address high-tier calibration challenges, and ensure maximum uptime for critical business environments. Additionally, you will maintain standard-setting response times and proactively contribute to the continuous improvement of the Technical Support Team’s printing diagnostic tools and processes.

Advanced Hardware & Software Troubleshooting

Hardware Maintenance: Expertly diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair print engines, label printers, and mobile printing units to significantly reduce customer downtime.
System Calibration: Configure menus, test sensors, and perform precise printhead adjustments to ensure optimal barcode and RFID readability.
Software Integration: Utilize industry-leading tools, including Zebra Setup Utilities and ZebraDesigner, for seamless device configuration and custom label design.

Customer Success & Escalation Management

Serve as the primary escalation point for resolving highly complex, diverse technical issues that require deep data analysis and critical thinking.
Deliver exceptional technical support to customers via telephone, email, and chat, demonstrating active listening and empathy in high-pressure situations.
Translate highly technical concepts into simple, easy-to-understand terms for both customers and internal management.

Leadership & Process Improvement

Act as a mentor and escalation point to support and guide less experienced agents on the team.
Develop, refine, and improve support processes, tools, and platform developments to enhance the overall customer experience.
Analyze data and prepare detailed reports on the effectiveness and efficiency of the support center.
Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors, internal technical teams, business leaders, and technology partners.

What We Are Looking For:

Education: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent vocational qualification/experience in a related technical field.
Experience: 4 to 5 years of proven experience in technical support, with a strong emphasis on hardware maintenance (printing devices, RFID, and mobile technology highly preferred).
Technical Proficiency: Full understanding of job-related procedures and intermediate to advanced skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to provide clear, concise information using proper professional language.
Core Competencies:
Strong customer service orientation with a dedication to resolving issues effectively.
Solid professional work behaviors (attendance, teamwork, time management).
Advanced problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate moderately complex factors.
Intermediate to advanced skills in task delegation and follow-up.

Why Join Us?

We offer a collaborative environment where your technical expertise is valued, and your career growth is supported. Help us keep the world's supply chains, hospitals, and retail floors running smoothly.




Benefits:

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

description:
About the job

Cada día tenemos oportunidades de generar un impacto positivo en nuestros colegas, socios, clientes y en la sociedad. Juntos, desarrollamos las soluciones del futuro y liberamos todo el potencial de los recursos esenciales.

Confiamos en que las personas actúen con iniciativa y desafíen las formas tradicionales de pensar para desarrollar tecnologías líderes a nivel mundial, capaces de impulsar el progreso en áreas fundamentales como la energía, los alimentos, el agua y la industria marina.

Mientras contribuimos a construir un mundo más eficiente y con menos desperdicios, también desarrollamos nuestras carreras en un entorno abierto, colaborativo e innovador.

Sobre El Rol

Estamos buscando un/a Customer Support para incorporarse a nuestro equipo y brindar soporte a nuestras operaciones en México y Centroamérica.

En esta posición, serás responsable de gestionar el ciclo completo de las órdenes de servicio, desde la aceptación de la cotización y la creación de la orden hasta su ejecución, cierre y facturación. Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con clientes y diferentes áreas internas para asegurar que las órdenes sean procesadas correctamente, ejecutadas dentro de los plazos establecidos y gestionadas de acuerdo con nuestros niveles de servicio.

Esta posición combina atención al cliente, gestión de órdenes, coordinación operativa y soporte al proceso de facturación. Es una excelente oportunidad para una persona que disfrute trabajar en un entorno dinámico, administrar múltiples prioridades y contribuir directamente a la satisfacción del cliente y a los resultados del negocio.

Principales Responsabilidades


Gestionar el ciclo completo de las órdenes, desde la aceptación de la cotización hasta el cierre de la orden y su facturación.
Crear, procesar y monitorear órdenes de servicio en el sistema ERP, asegurando la precisión de la información y una ejecución oportuna.
Revisar las órdenes de compra de los clientes y verificar que se encuentren alineadas con las cotizaciones, precios y condiciones comerciales acordadas.
Coordinar con Service Engineers, Field Service, Planning, Warehouse, Logistics, Procurement y Finance para asegurar el cumplimiento eficiente de las órdenes.
Mantener una comunicación proactiva con los clientes sobre el estado de sus órdenes, programación de servicios, fechas de entrega y actualizaciones relevantes.
Monitorear el avance de las órdenes, identificar posibles retrasos y coordinar acciones correctivas para minimizar el impacto en el cliente.
Asegurar que las solicitudes de los clientes sean atendidas de manera oportuna y profesional, de acuerdo con los niveles de servicio establecidos.
Apoyar las actividades de facturación, asegurando que la documentación de servicio esté completa, correcta y disponible dentro de los plazos requeridos.
Mantener actualizados y correctamente registrados los datos de clientes, órdenes y servicios en los sistemas internos.
Gestionar consultas, reclamos y situaciones escaladas de clientes, entregando soluciones oportunas o coordinando con las áreas internas correspondientes.
Colaborar con los equipos de Sales y Service para identificar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos y fortalecer la satisfacción del cliente.
Asegurar el cumplimiento de las políticas de la compañía, los estándares de calidad y los procedimientos de seguridad.


Requisitos


Formación profesional en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería, Supply Chain, Logística o carreras relacionadas. Este requisito es deseable.
Entre 2 y 5 años de experiencia en Customer Support, Customer Service, Order Management, Service Coordination, Sales Support o posiciones similares.
Experiencia gestionando órdenes de clientes o de servicio, desde su ingreso hasta la entrega, cierre o facturación.
Experiencia trabajando con sistemas ERP.
Conocimiento de procesos de gestión de órdenes y buenas prácticas de atención al cliente.
Experiencia revisando órdenes de compra, cotizaciones, precios o documentación comercial.
Fuertes habilidades de organización y gestión del tiempo.
Alta atención al detalle y precisión en el manejo de información.
Capacidad para gestionar múltiples prioridades y cumplir plazos en un entorno dinámico.
Habilidades de resolución de problemas y pensamiento analítico.
Excelentes habilidades interpersonales, de comunicación y de gestión de stakeholders.
Actitud proactiva, adaptabilidad y un alto sentido de responsabilidad.
Nivel de inglés intermedio


Nos preocupamos por la diversidad, la inclusión y la equidad en nuestros procesos de selección. También creemos que las características conductuales pueden entregar información relevante sobre el ajuste de una persona a un determinado rol.

Para ayudarnos en este proceso, utilizamos las evaluaciones de Pymetrics. Al momento de postular, recibirás una invitación para completar los juegos de evaluación.

Preparar reportes, presentaciones y análisis ejecutivos para apoyar la toma de decisiones. 
Monitorear tendencias de la industria, movimientos de la competencia y oportunidades de crecimiento para la marca.

Participar en procesos de planeación de negocio y revisiones periódicas de desempeño de marca. 



La Persona:

Te encanta aprender, crecer y ser reconocido por tus valiosas contribuciones. La innovación no te intimida. De hecho, lo adoptas ¿No sería genial poder hacer tu trabajo y, al mismo tiempo, hacer el bien en el mundo?. También cuentas con:



Licenciatura en Marketing, Administración, Negocios, Ingeniería Industrial, Economía o carreras afines. 
Experiencia previa en análisis de marca, marketing, consumer insights, category management o análisis comercial. 
Capacidad analítica sólida para interpretar datos y traducirlos en recomendaciones de negocio. 
Experiencia en manejo de herramientas de análisis y reporteo. 
Habilidad para desarrollar presentaciones ejecutivas claras y orientadas a la acción. 
Capacidad para trabajar en entornos dinámicos y colaborar con equipos multifuncionales. 
Nivel de inglés intermedio o avanzado



Detalles: 

Recibirás un salario competitivo y un excelente plan de beneficios.

Y Más:

Queremos que nuestra empresa sea un lugar donde quieras estar y permanecer. Ser parte de nuestro equipo significa que podrás:

Crecer: Formar parte de nuestra compañía global con más de 20 marcas para desarrollar tus habilidades a lo largo de múltiples trayectorias profesionales.

Aprender: Tener acceso a una gran variedad de recursos de aprendizaje, incluyendo nuestro portal digital.

Pertenecer: Experimentar un excelente ambiente de trabajo, donde existe respeto mutuo y una gran apreciación por una amplia gama de perspectivas y experiencias.

Contribuir: Ayudarnos a seguir generando cambios positivos a nivel local y global a través del voluntariado, la retribución y prácticas empresariales sostenibles.

Además, sentirás el orgullo de empoderar a creadores, hacedores, protectores y héroes cotidianos en todo el mundo. Somos más que la empresa de herramientas número uno. Más que una fuerza impulsora en equipos de energía para exteriores. Más que un líder global en el sector industrial. Somos visionarios e innovadores. Por exitosos que hayamos sido en el pasado, aún nos queda mucho por lograr. Ahí es donde entras tú. ¡Únete a nosotros!

About the job

¿Tu pasión es crear espacios que inspiren y enamoren a primera vista?

Esta oportunidad es para ti.




En Intimissimi México estamos en búsqueda de nuestro próximo Visual Merchandising Specialist, una persona creativa, organizada, estratégica y apasionada por la moda, capaz de transformar cada espacio en una historia que refleje la esencia de nuestra marca.




¿Qué buscamos?

✔ Experiencia de 2 años en Visual Merchandising dentro de fashion retail.

✔ Tenga un alto sentido estético y atención al detalle.

✔ Disfrute trabajar en campo, visitando nuestras boutiques para garantizar la correcta ejecución de los lineamientos, así como capacitar y acompañar a los equipos de venta para mantener los estándares visuales y la identidad de la marca.

✔ Sea capaz de analizar resultados y convertir el visual en una herramienta para impulsar las ventas.

✔ Esté apasionado por las tendencias, la moda y la experiencia del cliente.




Serás responsable de:

🎯 Implementar las estrategias de Visual Merchandising en nuestras boutiques.

🛍️ Garantizar que cada tienda represente la identidad y los estándares visuales de Intimissimi.

👥 Capacitar y acompañar a los equipos de venta, para asegurar la correcta ejecución de los lineamientos de Visual Merchandising.

📊 Analizar indicadores comerciales para identificar oportunidades de mejora a través del visual.

🤝 Colaborar con las diferentes áreas para garantizar una experiencia de compra excepcional.

✈️ Visitar boutiques a nivel nacional para supervisar la implementación de campañas, colecciones y estándares de la marca.

✨ Asegurar que cada espacio refleje la esencia, elegancia y sofisticación de la marca.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

✨ Formar parte de una marca italiana reconocida a nivel mundial.

✨ Un ambiente dinámico, creativo y enfocado en la moda.

✨ La oportunidad de dejar tu huella en cada una de nuestras boutiques en México.




📍 Ubicación: Ciudad de México (con alta disponibilidad para viajar).




Si te apasiona la moda y quieres formar parte de una marca que inspira elegancia, feminidad y sofisticación, nos encantaría conocerte.




📩 Aplica o compártelo por mensaje directo.

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com

At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:


Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. 
Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. 
Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. 


Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Executive Search who will:


Develop strong relationships with counterparts in WPP Media’s regional teams (Europe, United States and Asia). 
Support the implementation of digital campaigns and ads according to guidelines with platforms such as Google Ads, Bing Ads, Amazon Search, Search Ads 360, etc. 
Ensure campaigns comply with WPP Media’s global policies and guidelines. 
Monitor campaigns daily on each of the platforms and ensure accuracy of data across platforms for campaign reporting. 
Generate daily campaign reports for reporting to regional Search teams. 


Skills And Experience

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:


Bachelor’s degree. 
Advanced English level (B2–C2). 
Have 1.5-2 years of experience implementing paid Search campaigns on platforms such as Google Ads, Bing Ads, Amazon Search, etc. 
Advanced Excel skills.

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. Our benefits include access to internal learning platforms, certifications, and training sessions, life insurance, wellness programs, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, employee mental health awareness day, and more. 

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Desarrollador SEO

Ejecutar y optimizar la estrategia de posicionamiento orgánico de enviaflores.com mediante la implementación de acciones de SEO técnico, on-page y off-page, investigación de palabras clave, optimización de contenidos y análisis del desempeño orgánico.

• Monitorear actualizaciones de algoritmos de los principales motores de búsqueda y evaluar su impacto en el posicionamiento orgánico.

• Manejo de herramientas de análisis y optimización SEO: Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, entre otras.

• Conocimientos de HTML, CSS y estructura web.

• Conocimientos de SEO técnico, SEO on-page, SEO de contenidos y link building.

• Conocimientos de rastreo, indexación, arquitectura web, sitemap, robots.txt y metadatos.

• Conocimientos de análisis e interpretación de métricas de tráfico y posicionamiento.

• Capacidad para analizar información, identificar oportunidades y convertir hallazgos en acciones de optimización.

• Habilidad para trabajar de manera colaborativa con equipos multidisciplinarios.

• Capacidad de resolución de problemas.

• Organización y seguimiento.

• Comunicación efectiva.

• Adaptabilidad y actualización constante.

About the job

This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

Our client is a fast-growing consumer packaged goods (CPG) brand with a strong retail presence and an expanding direct-to-consumer e-commerce business. As the company continues to grow its online channel, they are building out their marketing team to strengthen customer retention, increase repeat purchases, and grow subscription revenue.

Role Overview

The Email & Retention Marketing Specialist will own the day-to-day execution and optimization of the brand’s email and SMS retention programs, with a primary focus on Klaviyo. The Email & Retention Marketing Specialist will work closely with the Senior Marketing Manager to improve existing lifecycle flows, execute ongoing campaigns, analyze performance, and identify opportunities to increase repeat purchases, subscriptions, and customer lifetime value.

This role is ideal for a hands-on retention marketer who combines strong lifecycle marketing experience with good visual judgment and an AI-native approach to their work. While email and retention will remain the core focus, the Email & Retention Marketing Specialist will also provide executional support across affiliate, influencer, and other day-to-day marketing initiatives as the brand’s DTC business continues to scale.

Location

Fully Remote | 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM PST

Key Responsibilities

Email & Lifecycle Marketing


Manage and execute ongoing email marketing campaigns within Klaviyo.
Audit, refine, and optimize existing lifecycle flows, including welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, and other retention-focused automations.
Develop segmentation and testing strategies to improve engagement, conversion, and overall email performance.
Support campaigns around product launches, promotions, subscriptions, and other key marketing initiatives.
Own email execution end-to-end, including campaign setup, copy, basic design, testing, QA, and deployment.


Retention & Subscription Growth

About Us

Some companies are in the business of banking. Others are in the business of shoes. Or sports. Or soft drinks. At EF, we're in a different kind of business. Between cultures.

For over half a century we’ve been the leader in international educational programs and experiences designed to foster such understanding. Through language, cultural exchange, academic studies, and educational travel, we create the kinds of immersive experiences that challenge biases, open minds, and pave the way for a more understanding world.

You’ll find our offices and schools located in some of the world’s greatest cities, and filled with smart, driven people (over 50,000 of us) who push each other to be better every day. But it’s what we do together - building greater understanding, breaking down barriers, and creating a better world - that makes all the difference.

Founded in 1965 in Sweden, EF (Education First) is a global association of education companies that share a common mission of opening the world through education. EF has been recognized on Forbes 2025 and 2024 World’s Best Employers and 2024 Top Companies for Women lists, Fast Company’s 2025 Next Big Things In Tech, and was a 2024 App Store Award winner in Cultural Impact.

EF English Live is powering the next generation of English language learning for millions of learners, worldwide. We’re reinventing education through a combination of real EF teachers and AI language learning technology with online English courses that simulates real-life scenarios. Join classes 24/7 from anywhere and progress faster with a method that works.

description:
About the job

We are PMG

PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Our work has earned top industry honors, including Cannes Lions and Adweek’s Media Plan of the Year, and PMG has won 40+ workplace culture awards, including being the only company to rank among Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for 11 consecutive years.

Who You’ll Be Working With

At PMG, our Influencer & Branded Content team is at the intersection of culture, storytelling, and strategy, helping brands connect with audiences in authentic, meaningful ways. We craft high-impact influencer campaigns that go beyond traditional advertising, driving engagement, building brand affinity, and delivering measurable results across social, digital, and experiential platforms.

You’ll collaborate with creators, talent agencies, media strategists, content teams, and brand partners to develop and execute influencer marketing programs that seamlessly align storytelling with business objectives. A key focus will be scaling PMG’s influencer and creator marketing discipline—establishing frameworks, curating talent relationships, and setting standards for authenticity and effectiveness in alignment with brand goals. Your role will be instrumental in shaping how brands foster meaningful connections with their audiences.

You will also play a role in exploring new content formats, leveraging emerging platforms, and staying ahead of industry trends to ensure creator strategies are not only relevant but also innovative and impactful. At PMG, we don’t just follow trends—we create them.

If you’re passionate about shaping culture through creator-driven storytelling, using data to drive real impact, and redefining what’s possible in influencer marketing, this is the place to make your mark.

What You Will Do


Assist in the identification and selection of influencers that align with our clients' target audiences and campaign objectives. 
Collaborate with Leaders to develop and execute comprehensive influencer campaigns, ensuring seamless coordination between influencers, internal teams, and clients. 
Take part in the creation and delivery of branded content, including overseeing the adherence to brand guidelines and coordinating with influencers and internal teams to achieve desired outcomes. 
Support the Senior Overseer in analyzing campaign performance, extracting key insights, and providing strategic recommendations for future campaigns. 
Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends, emerging platforms, and best practices in influencer marketing, and share relevant insights with the team. 
Ensure excellence in strategy, execution, and performance within the Influencer & Branded Content Channel. However, responsibilities may extend across other media channels as needed to support broader campaign objectives and business priorities. 
End to end campaign process, including outreach, negotiation, contracting and content reviews


What You Will Bring


1+ years of experience in Influencer & Branded Content, with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience. 
Experience in content creation and influencer marketing strategy, driving impactful partnerships and innovative campaigns. 
Experience in contract review and proposal development, ensuring smooth negotiations and long-term influencer collaborations. 
Advanced detail orientation, overseeing accurate execution, reporting, and strategic alignment in influencer initiatives. 
Strong proficiency in project implementation, managing high-level influencer campaigns from concept to completion. 
Skilled in presentation and communication, delivering insights, strategic recommendations, and campaign performance analysis. 
Deep understanding of advertising standards, client service, and relationship management, fostering high-quality influencer-brand partnerships. 
Proficiency in influencer management dashboards and social media platforms, leveraging analytics to optimize campaign performance. 
Experience in networking and influencer marketing, building meaningful industry relationships to enhance campaign reach and effectiveness. 
A commitment to curiosity and adaptability as a Continual Learner, staying at the forefront of media innovation while prioritizing client success with a Customer-Focused mindset that seeks opportunities to deliver meaningful value. 
A dedication to People-Focused leadership, fostering collaboration, innovation, and professional growth by leading by example and nurturing strong relationships that empower others to excel. 


What We Offer


Professional Development: Take advantage of our learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, and career advancement support. 
Generous Time Off: Enjoy generous paid time off and holiday allowances to recharge and spend time with loved ones. 
Parental Leave: We provide paid parental leave to support your family during important life events. 
Retirement & Pension Plans: Plan for your future with competitive retirement or pension programs, including contribution matching. 
Fertility and Family Support: Access fertility benefits for all team members and their spouses. 
Healthcare: Coverage and support for everyday medical expenses and routine care, tailored by geography. 
Pet Insurance: Protect your pet's health and your finances. 
Lifestyle Spending Accounts: Enjoy 100% company-funded accounts to promote healthy habits and well-being. 
Commuter Benefits: Access support for travel and commuting needs, where available. 
Annual Bonus: All employees are eligible for an annual bonus. 
Volunteering Opportunities: Receive 8 give-back hours to volunteer in your local communities.

Benefits vary by country, location, and geography to reflect local laws, norms, and expectations.

What Sets Us Apart

Being part of PMG means joining a company culture that’s unmatched in digital. We're dedicated to working hard to serve our employees and clients, delivering value, results, and innovation—which often requires true grit and agility. We believe in taking care of ourselves and each other to continuously improve in every way.

In alignment with our core values to be inclusive and always change for the better, PMG is committed to creating a more diverse and inclusive culture, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. description:
About the job

VoIP Engineer

Location: Mexico – Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: Competitive / Based on experience




About the Role

We are looking for a VoIP Engineer to join our team and support the implementation, administration, monitoring, and troubleshooting of Voice over IP (VoIP) and Unified Communications environments.




The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in networking and telecommunications, hands-on experience with VoIP technologies, and a solid understanding of SIP-based communications. This person will help ensure reliable, secure, and high-quality voice services while collaborating with technical teams, carriers, vendors, and other stakeholders.




Key Responsibilities

Configure, administer, monitor, and troubleshoot VoIP and Unified Communications environments.
Manage and support SIP trunks, call routing, dial plans, voice gateways, and Session Border Controllers (SBCs).
Troubleshoot voice quality and connectivity issues, including latency, jitter, packet loss, dropped calls, one-way audio, and codec-related problems.
Analyze SIP signaling and RTP traffic to identify and resolve technical issues.
Support PBX, cloud telephony, and hybrid voice environments.
Monitor voice infrastructure performance, availability, and call quality.
Configure and maintain routing rules, extensions, DIDs, call queues, and related telephony services.
Coordinate with telecom carriers and vendors regarding SIP trunking, number provisioning, connectivity, and service incidents.
Assist with VoIP deployments, migrations, upgrades, and infrastructure changes.
Collaborate with Network, Infrastructure, Security, and IT teams to ensure reliable end-to-end voice connectivity.
Document configurations, network diagrams, troubleshooting procedures, and technical changes.
Participate in root-cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives.




Requirements

3+ years of experience in VoIP, Telecommunications, Network Engineering, Unified Communications, or a related technical role.
Strong understanding of VoIP technologies and SIP-based communications.
Hands-on knowledge of SIP, RTP, SRTP, TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, NAT, VLANs, and QoS.
Experience troubleshooting VoIP call flows and voice quality issues.
Experience working with SIP trunks, PBX systems, voice gateways, or SBCs.
Solid understanding of networking fundamentals and how network performance impacts voice services.
Experience with troubleshooting and network analysis tools such as Wireshark or similar platforms.
Ability to diagnose complex technical issues and perform root-cause analysis.
Strong documentation and communication skills.
Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
English proficiency sufficient to communicate effectively in a professional and technical environment.




Nice to Have

Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable:

Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM)
Microsoft Teams Phone / Direct Routing
Cisco CUBE
AudioCodes, Ribbon, Oracle/Acme Packet, or other SBC platforms
Asterisk, FreePBX, or similar PBX technologies
Cisco Webex
Zoom Phone
Contact Center / CCaaS platforms
Microsoft 365 / Entra ID
Cloud-based telephony or UCaaS environments
PowerShell or scripting/automation
Telecom carrier integrations
ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow

Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP Collaboration, Microsoft Teams certifications, or equivalent telecom/networking certifications are a plus.




What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with a hands-on troubleshooting mindset. The ideal candidate is comfortable investigating complex voice and network issues, communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and taking ownership of problems through resolution.




This is a great opportunity for a VoIP or Network Engineer looking to work remotely while supporting modern voice and Unified Communications technologies.

title: Jefe de DevOps
description:
About the job

Descripción de la empresa GRUPO NORTE 70 es una empresa comprometida con la excelencia en la gestión y servicios de apoyo. Nos enfocamos en proporcionar soluciones innovadoras, eficientes y de alta calidad a nuestros clientes. Nuestro equipo trabaja con profesionalismo y dedicación para superar las expectativas y establecer relaciones a largo plazo.




Descripción del puesto

Buscamos un/a DevOps Manager con visión estratégica, liderazgo técnico y capacidad hands-on, que sea el punto de conexión entre los equipos de desarrollo e infraestructura.




Tu misión

Liderar la estrategia DevOps y la evolución de nuestra infraestructura tecnológica, diseñando arquitecturas confiables, seguras, automatizadas y escalables que permitan soportar múltiples productos y entornos de operación.




Serás responsable de transformar necesidades de negocio y producto en soluciones de infraestructura reales, eficientes y de alta disponibilidad, liderando al equipo DevOps y promoviendo mejores prácticas de automatización, despliegue, observabilidad y operación.




Responsabilidades principales

* Diseñar y evolucionar arquitecturas Cloud, On-Premise e híbridas, enfocadas en alta disponibilidad, seguridad, escalabilidad y bajo mantenimiento.

* Liderar la implementación y mejora continua de prácticas DevOps, CI/CD, GitOps y observabilidad end-to-end.

* Administrar y optimizar infraestructura sobre AWS, utilizando servicios como EKS, ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3, Route 53, EC2, IAM y CloudWatch.

* Diseñar y administrar entornos contenerizados utilizando Docker, Kubernetes y Helm.

* Implementar y mantener soluciones autogestionadas como MinIO, Coolify, N8N, Vault, Portainer, GitLab, entre otras.

* Construir plataformas y servicios autoescalables, seguros, auditables y altamente disponibles.

* Desarrollar herramientas y automatizaciones para mejorar la eficiencia operativa utilizando Python, Bash y/o Go.

It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.
