Interview Scheduling & Coordination: Manage and coordinate interview schedules with candidates, hiring managers, and interviewers to ensure timely and professional interview logistics.
Offer & Pre-boarding Support:
Assist in the preparation and issuance of offer letters ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery.
Facilitate background checks, tracking progress, and resolving any related issues.
Onboarding Coordination:
Support pre-boarding activities, including new hire documentation and orientation scheduling.
Ensure a smooth transition for new hires, resolving any onboarding-related concerns efficiently.
Process Oversight: Monitor all aspects of the recruitment lifecycle, ensuring timely completion of each stage while maintaining high service standards.
Data Management & Reporting
Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate records within the ATS and other recruitment systems.
Ensure data integrity and compliance with company policies and data privacy regulations.
Generate basic reports on recruitment activities, tracking process completion rates, candidate status, and coordination efficiency.
Stakeholder Management & Communication
Build and maintain strong relationships with Recruiters, Hiring Managers, HR Teams, and Candidates.
Provide timely updates on the status of coordination activities, ensuring clear communication and alignment.
Ensure candidates receive a high-touch experience, keeping them informed throughout the interview and hiring process.
Process Improvement & Technology Utilization
Identify and suggest process improvements to streamline coordination activities and enhance efficiency.
Utilize the ATS, CRM, and other recruitment tools to ensure timely and accurate execution of coordination activities.
Stay updated on system and process changes, ensuring proper adoption and compliance.
Compliance & Process Adherence
Ensure all recruitment activities comply with local employment laws, company policies, and global hiring standards.
Maintain accurate data entry and tracking within the ATS, ensuring full compliance with recruitment lifecycle protocols.
Safeguard the accuracy and completeness of candidate records, ensuring adherence to data privacy regulations.
Specialized Responsibilities Based on Coordination Type
Coordinate high-volume hiring processes for external professional, early talent, and frontline recruitment.
Work closely with campus recruitment teams, operations managers, and talent partners to ensure timely hiring.
Manage external candidate engagement, ensuring a smooth recruitment journey from interview scheduling to onboarding.


Qualifications

Who Are We Looking For?

Required Qualifications


Education & Experience: Bachelor’s Degree and 2+ years of experience in recruitment coordination, HR operations, or talent acquisition support.
Talent Acquisition Technology Expertise: Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) (e.g., iCIMS, Workday, SuccessFactors) and recruitment technologies.
Organizational & Time Management Skills: Strong ability to manage multiple priorities, high-volume hiring processes, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
Process & Compliance Adherence: Understanding of global hiring standards, local employment laws, and recruitment lifecycle protocols to ensure compliance and data integrity.
Attention to Detail: Strong focus on accuracy in offer processing, scheduling, and data management to maintain seamless recruitment coordination.
Collaboration & Confidentiality: Ability to work collaboratively across teams while maintaining discretion in handling sensitive candidate information.
Candidate Experience Management: Strong customer service orientation to ensure a high-touch candidate experience throughout the interview and onboarding process.
Proficiency in English: Strong written and spoken English skills to support recruitment coordination across regions.


Preferred Qualifications


High-Volume Hiring Expertise: Experience supporting external professional, early talent, or frontline hiring processes in a high-volume recruitment environment.
HR Systems & Data Management: Familiarity with recruitment workflows, HR processes, and system-generated analytics to support reporting and insights.
Process Improvement Mindset: Ability to identify opportunities for operational efficiency and suggest enhancements to streamline coordination activities.
Campus & Early Talent Coordination: Experience partnering with campus recruitment teams or managing early talent hiring processes.

And because your family is also important to us, they can also enjoy benefits such as our Wellness Line, thousands of Agreements and Discounts, Scholarship programs for your children, Aid Plans for different moments of life, among others.

description:
About the job

Who We Are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is looking for a detail-oriented and motivated Sales Process Coordinator to support our sales operations team in executing repetitive and high-volume sales processes with accuracy and speed. This role is ideal for someone early in their career who thrives in structured environments and is eager to learn about sales operations in a high-growth tech company. You’ll be responsible for ensuring accuracy in data entry, validation of basic contract requirements, and supporting internal teams with operational requests.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in Mexico. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:



You’re reliable, detail-oriented, and value consistency and accuracy. 
You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You’re excited to build a career in operations and want to learn how a fast-growing company runs. 
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You enjoy solving problems and following clear processes. 
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. 
You thrive in a team environment and take pride in helping others succeed.



In this role, you will:



Perform data entry and validation tasks for sales requests and documentation.
Support ticket intake, triage, and process routing.
Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure required documentation is complete.
Ensure contract and system data is updated correctly in Salesforce and related tools.
Maintain accurate records for audit and compliance purposes.
Escalate process exceptions or errors as needed.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team).



Minimum requirements for the role:



Less than 1 year of experience in a support, operations, or administrative role.
High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
Effective communication skills in both English and Spanish.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, repetitive task environment.
Basic experience using tools like Google Sheets or Excel.
Interest in learning Salesforce or other CRM systems.



An ideal candidate also has:



Experience working with cross-functional teams or in a remote setting.
Prior experience with ticketing tools such as Zendesk.



Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.
